note: Fees, terminal modules, shop categories and airline naming. Money in the game currency. sandboxCash is the cash a sandbox game holds, topped up at every daily close so no build is ever refused for money (T35, owner 2026-11-23).

skipDay.note: Skip to the next morning (T92, owner 2026-11-24): the sim runs every tick at the rate of one game day in realSeconds until the clock reads untilMinute.

fixtureCosts.note: Build cost per asset id, T75. Travelator pairs by length (T77, owner 2026-11-23) carry no upkeep

fixtureLevels.note: Fixture levels 1 to 3 (T74, owner 2026-11-22). Index 0 is level 1. cost is the build cost of a level, an upgrade pays the difference. serviceSeconds of levels 2 and 3 from src/data/fixtures/catalog.json, level 1 keeps the module and mode values. worksDays closes the fixture while it is upgraded. premiumPenalty is lost by premium passengers checked in below premiumLevel.

props.note: Props on the 0.5 m sub grid (T76, owner 2026-11-22). costByCategory is the build cost of one prop by catalog category; seating costs perSeat per seat, decoration perAmbience per ambience point, and costById overrides both. Removal refunds the full cost. upkeepPctPerMonth of the cost is booked daily. blockShare of a 2 m cell covered by floor and wall props makes it unwalkable. Rating: comfort counts seats times (1 + comfortWeight times comfort) against seatsPerGateDesk per gate desk (at least one desk), ambience counts points against one per ambienceAreaM2 of passenger floor; toiletServersTarget washroom servers give the full toilet term. Converted seating cells hold two bench.beam3, converted toilet blocks two washroom.wcStall.
props.effectsNote: T82 (owner, 2026-11-23). vendingNeeds lists the passenger needs each vending machine meets, as a small shop whose sales share comes from the catalog. adPerPax is the income of an ad prop per daily passenger; one ad slot pays per paxPerAdSlot daily passengers, best paying ads first. Wayfinding counts props with the wayfinding stat against one per wayfindingAreaM2 of passenger floor.

tower.note: Free standing ATC tower, confirmed by the user on 2026-11-06. Money in the game currency, footprint side in meters. Index 0 of levels is level 1. movementsPerHour is the landing and takeoff budget per runway in a rolling 60 minute window. maxRunways is the most runways the level allows, minus 1 means unlimited.

useAreas.note: Use areas (T85, owner 2026-11-24): the floor a fixture or prop needs clear around it, shown on its ghost and checked at placement. For a fixture, front cells lie on the side people use (the bottom edge of its sprite) and back cells on the staff side (the top edge), in 2 m cells; a transition fixture has front on its entry side and back on its exit side. Fixtures not listed need none. A prop needs propFrontM in front of the side people use, by catalog category; 0 means none. Queues of a listed fixture start on its front side.
